56 csepp vér (2006 Hungarian pop-musical, music by Tamás Mihály, book and lyrics by Péter Horváth; Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet transposed to the Hungarian Revolution of October 1956 in a small border town; revived 2026 at the József Attila Színház, Budapest)

Use ONLY these characters, with exactly these relationships: Eke Máté the Captain of the Tenkes; Veronika; Siklósi bácsi; Buga Jakab; brigadier Béri Balogh Ádám; colonel Eberstein Echbert and Amália his WIFE; sergeant Pityik; captain Bruckenbacker Alfonz; Dudva the innkeeper; Rózsa a gypsy girl; the General and Helén his wife)
